title: Step 3 - Implementing Feature Scaling: Fit and Transform Methods Explained

cues.en: Instructor: All right, good.
cues.zh: 很好。

cues.en: Now I'm gonna give you the solution.
cues.zh: 現在揭曉做法。

cues.en: So first of all, we're gonna fit our scaler, you know our standardization tool on the training set.
cues.zh: 首先，將縮放器，也就是標準化工具，擬合到訓練集。

cues.en: So I'm taking the training set first X_train.
cues.zh: 所以先取出 X_train。

cues.en: All right.
cues.zh: 好。

cues.en: And then since I've just explained that we won't apply feature scaling on the demi variables well then that means that we will fit our standard scaler object only
cues.zh: 剛才解釋過，不會縮放虛擬變數，所以 StandardScaler 只會擬合

cues.en: on these two columns here containing the ages and the salaries.
cues.zh: 這兩個包含年齡與薪資的欄位。

cues.en: And therefore here I'm gonna take only the two columns here for the age and the salary.
cues.zh: 因此，只選年齡與薪資這兩欄。

cues.en: And then of course, all the rows.
cues.zh: 列則全部保留。

cues.en: And remember the trick to take all the rows, we just need to add a colon which means we are taking the range from the lower bound to the upper bound, meaning everything.
cues.zh: 別忘了，選取所有列只要寫冒號，表示從最下界到最上界，也就是全部。

cues.en: And then to take the columns, well be careful this is what we have to look at, not this because indeed we want to take this column and this one.
cues.zh: 欄位方面，要看的是目前這個矩陣，而不是原始資料，因為我們要的是這兩欄。

cues.en: And so now the question is, what are the indexes of these columns?
cues.zh: 它們的索引是多少？

cues.en: Well, remember that indexes and Python start from zero.
cues.zh: Python 索引從 0 起算。

cues.en: So this has index zero.
cues.zh: 這一欄索引是 0。

cues.en: Then the second column has index one, index two, and this one has index three.
cues.zh: 第二欄索引是 1，再來是 2，這一欄則是 3。

cues.en: The age column has index three and the salary column has index four.
cues.zh: Age 的索引是 3，Salary 的索引是 4。

cues.en: But since I wanna make this template as much generic as we can, and since when you one hot end code your category core variables they always automatically go as the fourth column.
cues.zh: 為了讓模板盡可能通用，而且獨熱編碼的類別欄位會自動移到前面，

cues.en: Well, we're gonna do something even better.
cues.zh: 我們可以用更好的寫法。

cues.en: We're gonna specify the indexes we want here by three which is the index of the H column and then a simple column.
cues.zh: 在這裡指定索引 3，也就是 Age 欄，再接一個冒號。

cues.en: Right?
cues.zh: 對吧？

cues.en: Because this will take the range from the column of index three, which is the age, up to all the other columns.
cues.zh: 這會從索引 3 的 Age 欄開始，取出後面的所有欄位。

cues.en: You know, there is not the minus one here.
cues.zh: 這裡沒有 -1。

cues.en: So this will take all the remaining columns from the age meaning the age, and the salary.
cues.zh: 所以會保留從 Age 開始的全部剩餘欄位，也就是 Age 與 Salary。

cues.en: Basically, this will take these two columns.
cues.zh: 基本上就是這兩欄。

cues.en: And if you have a larger matrix of features with numerical values in your features, well this will just take all the columns.
cues.zh: 如果特徵矩陣更大，後面還有其他數值特徵，就會把它們全部取出。

cues.en: All right?
cues.zh: 明白嗎？

cues.en: So that's a little trick, more elegant, let's say.
cues.zh: 這算是一個更簡潔的小技巧。

cues.en: And so now we are of course going to use our object which we called sc, from, which well, we're gonna use that fit method that will indeed,
cues.zh: 接著當然使用先前命名為 sc 的物件，呼叫 fit，

cues.en: for each feature of X train, compute the mean of the feature, meaning the mean of the age, and then the mean of the salary.
cues.zh: 它會針對 X_train 的每個特徵，計算平均數，也就是平均年齡與平均薪資。

cues.en: And then compute the standard deviation of the feature the age and the salary.
cues.zh: 再計算各個特徵，也就是年齡與薪資的標準差。

cues.en: And that's exactly what the fit method will do.
cues.zh: 這就是 fit 所做的事。

cues.en: It will only compute the mean and the standard deviation of all the values.
cues.zh: 只計算各欄全部數值的平均數與標準差。

cues.en: And then you have the transform method that will indeed apply this formula by, you know, transforming each of the values here if each feature into this value resulting
cues.zh: 而 transform 則會套用公式，把每個特徵中的每個值，轉成

cues.en: from this formula.
cues.zh: 這個公式所產生的新值。

cues.en: All right, so it's important to understand the difference between fit and transform.
cues.zh: 理解 fit 與 transform 的差別非常重要。

cues.en: Fit will just get the mean and send the deviation of each of your features, and transform will apply this formula to indeed transform your values so that they can all be in the same scale.
cues.zh: fit 取得每個特徵的平均數與標準差；transform 套用公式，將它們轉成相同尺度。

cues.en: All right?
cues.zh: 好嗎？

cues.en: And now, the good news is that one of the methods of the standard scale of class is actually fit transform, which of course will proceed to the two tools at the same time.
cues.zh: 好消息是，StandardScaler 也提供 fit_transform，能一次完成兩件事。

cues.en: Meaning it'll fit your matrix of features to get the mean and standard deviation.
cues.zh: 先對特徵矩陣擬合，取得平均數與標準差。

cues.en: And then right after that, transform all the values of the features to turn them into this formula.
cues.zh: 隨後立即轉換所有特徵值，套用這個公式。

cues.en: All right?
cues.zh: 明白嗎？

cues.en: So let's call this method right away to make it efficient, you know, fit_transform, then some parenthesis.
cues.zh: 為了效率，直接呼叫 fit_transform，再加括號。

cues.en: And now obviously you know what to input inside this fit transform method.
cues.zh: 現在你應該知道括號裡要填什麼。

cues.en: While that's of course exactly the same as extra in here because indeed we will only apply feature scaling
cues.zh: 當然是這裡 X_train 的相同切片，因為只會對

cues.en: to our numerical columns here containing non integer values, right?
cues.zh: 這些包含一般數值的欄位進行縮放，

cues.en: Non dummy variables, values.
cues.zh: 而不處理虛擬變數。
